title: Indie Essentials
subtitle: a house canon of the modern indies, Braid to Balatro
blurb: 24 essentials in any order — about 197 hours of story where a story clock exists, and three games that never end.
notes: No list like this is neutral and this one does not pretend to be: 24 games, curated here, in release order because that is the story of the scene. If one is not for you, skip it loudly; if one is missing, that is what the group chat is for.
Nothing leads to anything else — pick whatever tonight feels like. The sections are eras, not a sequence.

Stardew Valley, Slay the Spire and Balatro are built to never end, so they are marked optional and weigh nothing rather than wearing a made-up number. Tick them when you feel done — that is the only honest rule.
HowLongToBeat main-story figures — credits, not completion. Hollow Knight and Disco Elysium in particular go far past their numbers.
Every title verified against its own Wikipedia article; hours from HowLongToBeat main-story figures, matched by name and year.
